cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Every Loss Builds the Comeback
cards.instruction: Treat each setback as proof that the eventual victory will be more impressive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six losses! Our comeback will need its own documentary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Next season's trophy, then. Keep the six losses in the film; I'll book a practice court.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A reunion victory will be even better. Pick the date; I'll get everyone back for it.

reason: A offers court booking and reunion organizing while treating each new barrier as making the eventual win more impressive, not a second-act explanation.
